source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A facility meeting rigorous standards for advanced stroke care, including 24/7 availability of specialized treatments such as mechanical thrombectomy","B":"A certification that remains available to essentially any hospital, regardless of its actual clinical resources, staffing, or equipment","C":"A designation generally considered to carry fairly little meaningful clinical significance for the quality of care a client receives","D":"A hospital that actually has fairly limited stroke-specific care capabilities when compared with other certified stroke centers"}}
source_row.rationale: Comprehensive Stroke Center certification recognizes a facility meeting rigorous standards for advanced stroke care, including 24/7 availability of specialized treatments such as mechanical thrombectomy and neurocritical care.
source_row.source_detail: Requirements for Comprehensive Stroke Center Designation
